item.title: PS5 LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Console Display Build (PDF)
item.description: Build a miniature PlayStation 5 from LEGO® bricks! This compact PS5 MOC recreates the iconic curved white panels and sleek black centre strip in micro scale. Perfect as a desk display or shelf piece for any gamer and LEGO® fan. Easy to follow for builders of all ages.

item.title: XBOX SERIES X LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Console Display Build (PDF)
item.description: Build a miniature Xbox Series X from LEGO® bricks! The tall, bold tower design recreated in micro scale — just 7 pieces and perfectly display-worthy. Great for any gaming fan's desk or shelf.

item.title: XBOX SERIES S LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Console Display Build (PDF)
item.description: Build a miniature Xbox Series S from LEGO® bricks! The compact all-digital console recreated in LEGO® micro scale — only 5 pieces and instantly recognisable. Perfect for desk displays and gaming setups.

item.title: YELLOW GO-KART LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Go-Kart Display Build (PDF)

item.title: XBOX ONE S LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Console Display Build (PDF)
item.description: A brilliant micro-scale LEGO® MOC of the classic Xbox One S! Slightly larger than its successor with 12 pieces, capturing the clean white design and iconic Xbox styling — perfect for your gaming desk or LEGO collection.

item.title: AMONG US CHARACTER LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Display Build (PDF)
item.description: Build a miniature Among Us crewmate from LEGO® bricks! The iconic bean-shaped character with its signature backpack and visor, recreated brick by brick in 38 pieces. A fun display piece for any Among Us fan's desk or shelf.

item.title: GAMING CHAIR LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Display Build (PDF)
item.description: Build a miniature gaming chair from LEGO® bricks! Complete with a tall backrest, padded armrests, and a swivel base, this micro-scale build is the perfect companion piece for your LEGO gaming desk setup. Just 16 pieces.

item.title: GAMING DESK LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Display Build (PDF)
item.description: Build a miniature gaming desk from LEGO® bricks! Featuring a sleek tabletop, side drawers, and a side-panel leg, this micro-scale desk is designed to pair perfectly with your LEGO gaming chair and monitor builds. Just 17 pieces.

item.description: Build a miniature gaming monitor from LEGO® bricks! A simple, clean monitor-and-stand build in just 5 pieces — perfect for slotting straight onto your LEGO gaming desk setup.

item.title: CREEPER FACE FRAME LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Display Build (PDF)
item.description: Build a hangable creeper-face frame from LEGO® bricks! The blocky pixelated face you know from your favourite sandbox game, built as a wall-ready display piece complete with a hanging loop. 28 pieces.

item.title: NARUTO KUNAI LEGO® MOC Instructions – Life-Size Display Build (PDF)
item.description: Build a life-size kunai throwing knife from LEGO® bricks! A sleek, full-scale blade design with a looped handle, inspired by classic ninja weaponry from anime. A fun 28-piece build for any anime fan's shelf.

item.title: 1965 CHEVROLET C10 – Classic American Pickup (PDF)
item.description: Build an iconic 1960s Chevrolet C10 from LEGO® bricks. Features authentic two-tone paint design, functional suspension, detailed truck bed, and proportionate bodywork. Perfect for collectors of classic vehicles.

item.title: OFFICE DESK LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Display Build (PDF)
item.description: Build a miniature office desk from LEGO® bricks! A clean, modern design with a flat tabletop and double-door cabinet base, in just 13 pieces. A versatile little build for any LEGO miniature room scene.

item.title: PC TOWER LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Display Build (PDF)

item.title: ROBLOX LOGO LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Display Build (PDF)
item.description: Build a miniature Roblox-style logo block from LEGO® bricks! A nested-square design that captures the game's iconic blocky logo shape in 27 pieces. A fun little display piece for any Roblox fan's desk.

item.title: FORTNITE PENCIL HOLDER LEGO® MOC Instructions – Desk Organiser Build (PDF)

item.title: NINTENDO SWITCH (BIG) LEGO® MOC Instructions – Larger Display Build (PDF)

item.title: HEART LEGO® MOC Instructions – Sweet Love Build (PDF)
item.description: A sweet little 5-piece LEGO® heart build — perfect as a gift, Valentine's decoration, or desk display. Simple enough for beginners but full of charm.

item.title: JEEP LEGO® MOC Instructions – Off-Road Adventure Build (PDF)
item.description: A rugged LEGO® Jeep with authentic styling, detailed body work, working suspension, and incredible engineering. The perfect build for vehicle enthusiasts and collectors.

item.title: SKIBIDI TOILET LEGO® MOC Instructions – Mini Display Build (PDF)
item.description: A fun, meme-inspired LEGO® MOC build featuring the internet-famous Skibidi Toilet crew. Perfect for a laugh on the shelf or as a quirky gift for any LEGO® fan who's terminally online.
